t: r/backpacks on Reddit: Are Kipling backpacks generally good quality and long-lasting?
s: March 1, 2023 - I work in warehouses, so it's pretty dirty and there's not anything that I have done to any of my bags that I haven't been able to scrub out. I buy certain ones brand new, like my · Star Wars pencil bag that I keep my phone in at work. But my greatest thrill is finding them in the wild in thrift stores, so I see them when they've been used. Kipling wallets, I wouldn't bother with.
